articles.title: How South Korea is trying to catch cheats in ‘hardest exam in the world’ | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 韩国如何试图在“世界上最难的考试”中抓到作弊者 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Flights diverted, offices opening late and internet access cut off near exams halls. Some of the extraordinary measures South Korea is taking as it struggles with an AI cheating scandal that's threatening what's considered one of the toughest exams in the world. We explain how this controversy emerged, hear from students and learn how the authorities are fighting back.

In this video:
00:00 – An AI exam cheating scandal grips South Korea
01:11 – What is the Suneung exam and why is it so difficult?
02:00 – How important is the exam for South Koreans?
02:46 – What’s it like sitting the exam?
03:17 – What is the AI controversy?
04:26 – How are authorities tackling the problem?
05:20 – What’s been the reaction of students?
06:04 – How are other countries tackling AI in education?
07:06 – Has the scandal rocked confidence in AI in South Korea?

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: What we found out after Putin, Xi and Trump's historic meeting | BBC Newscast
articles.titleZh: 普京、习近平和特朗普历史性会晤后我们发现了什么 | BBC 新闻播报
articles.summary:
Nuclear deterrence, the future of AI, and the war in Ukraine were all on the table for Presidents Trump, Xi and Putins historic trilateral meeting in China. But what was actually up for grabs, and what did the three presidents, each trying to position themselves as one of the most powerful people on the planet, accomplish at their historic first joint meeting?

Adam and Chris are joined by James Landale our diplomatic correspondent, Laura Bicker our China correspondent, and Nada Tawfik our North America correspondent to break down what we know about the meeting.

New episodes released every day. If you're in the UK, for more News and Current Affairs podcasts from the BBC, listen on BBC Sounds: bbc.in/4guXgXd

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews #Newscast #Trump #Xi #Putin

articles.readingTextZh:
在特朗普总统、习近平主席和普京总统于中国举行的历史性三方会晤中，核威慑、人工智能的未来以及乌克兰战争均被提上议程。

但实际上，三位总统在他们历史性的首次联席会议上争夺的是什么，以及他们各自试图将自己定位为地球上最有权势的人之一，又取得了什么成就？

每天发布新剧集。

articles.title: Is AI a threat to democracy? | The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 人工智能是对民主的威胁吗？|全球故事
articles.summary:
As China races to catch up with the US on artificial intelligence, the AI revolution is raising questions that go beyond superpower competition. 

It’s a test of two political systems - autocracies vs democracies. Which system is better equipped to handle the revolutionary power of this new technology? Could massive economic upheavals caused by AI start to fracture both systems?

In this episode Tristan Redman and Asma Khalid speak to Laura Bicker, the BBC’s China correspondent, and Jill Lepore, Pulitzer-winning historian and writer.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

00:00 Intro: Who should control AI?
02:16 China's Great Firewall and internet control
05:16 China's AI race and state control
07:10 AI safety and global rules
08:40 AI, jobs and social unrest in China
10:44 Does autocracy give China an edge?
12:08 Jill Lepore: How tech got tied to democracy
14:47 Sci-fi fantasies of the tech titans
18:16 Big Tech borrowing the language of democracy
20:18 The biggest risk: alienation
22:35 Autocracy vs democracy: who's better placed?

#ai #china #usa #BBCNews

articles.title: Trump’s cyber director quits; DHS chief sidelined; new cyberattacks

articles.summary:
Trump's National Cyber Director, Sean Cairncross, has stepped down after multiple major tech outages disrupted people's lives nationwide. articles.readingText:
Trump's National Cyber Director, Sean Cairncross, has stepped down after multiple major tech outages disrupted people's lives nationwide.

Also, Secretary of Homeland Security, Markwayne Mullin, has reportedly been sidelined from TV appearances after multiple controversial press appearances in the wake of the attacks.

Meanwhile, an ex-NSA Hacker says there's been another major, yet-to-be-reported cyberattack.
articles.readingTextZh:

此外，据报道，国土安全部部长马克韦恩·穆林（Markwayne Mullin）在袭击事件发生后多次在媒体上发表有争议的言论，因此被禁止上电视。

与此同时，一位前美国国家安全局（NSA）黑客表示，又发生了一起尚未被报道的重大网络攻击事件。
